hints.title: Row Multiplicity Requirement
hints.text: If a number appears k times in nums, it must appear in at least k distinct rows, meaning the 2D array needs at least max(frequencies) rows.

hints.title: Frequency Bucket Assignment
hints.text: Place the c-th occurrence of number x into the c-th row of the resulting matrix.

hints.title: Dynamic Row Expansion
hints.text: When encountering an occurrence count that exceeds the current number of rows, append a new row to accommodate it.

hints.title: Frequency-Based Row Partitioning Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def findMatrix(self, nums: list[int]) -> list[list[int]]:
        from collections import defaultdict
        count = defaultdict(int)
        res = []
        for x in nums:
            r = count[x]
            if r == len(res):
                res.append([])
            res[r].append(x)
            count[x] += 1
        return res
```

complexity.notes: Single pass placing each element into its corresponding frequency row.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Repeatedly searching for available rows takes O(n^2) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) frequency map and output list.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognizes that the c-th instance of any number belongs in row c.
